subject: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence scope, DPA alignment, and pen-test cadence
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@novaterra.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-27 15:02 PST
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence scope, DPA alignment, and pen-test cadence

Hi Jane / Carlos —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep your security team moving forward. If I missed anything, please flag it and I’ll update.

Summary of what you described
- Primary risk surface: audit-log access for transaction tracing and retention for regulatory reporting (7 years for settlements).
- SOC 2 skepticism: your auditors want a concise artifact set + a clear retention and access-control mapping.
- Pen test: Novaterra prefers a vendor-managed window with agreed scope and notification cadence; goal is to run tests before production roll-out.

What Redwood can provide (short-term / deliverables)
1) SOC 2 one-page summary + artifact index (controls, where artifacts live) — deliverable: RDW_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (attached).
2) Retention matrix mapping (API logs, audit logs, KV cache traces) to retention policies and encryption key ownership — deliverable: Retention_Matrix_v1.xlsx (attached).
3) Draft DPA redline focused on logging & deletion clauses — DPA_Redwood_v0.9.docx (attached).
4) Pen-test scope template and proposed cadence (we can accommodate a 2-week test window, sandbox endpoint, and a read-only trace export) — PenTest_Scope_Template.pdf (attached).

Proposed timeline and owners
- By 2026-11-30: I’ll drop the SOC2 summary + retention matrix into the shared Drive. (owner: me)
- By 2026-12-03: Neha will follow up with the artifact retrieval plan and temporary access for your audit team. (owner: neha_kapoor)
- Week of 2026-12-07: Jordan will scope the pen-test window and provide a test access token and ephemeral sandbox. (owner: jordan_blake)

Immediate asks for Novaterra (helpful to confirm)
- Confirm the retention horizon you require for API request logs vs. audit logs (7 years vs. 1 year? — your comment suggested 7 years for settlements).
- Confirm whether your pen-test vendor needs a non-prod copy of PII or if masking is acceptable.
- If you have a DPA template with your security/legal redlines, please attach it to the Drive link and we’ll produce a redline.

Shared links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRDW-Novaterra-Evidence

Next steps:
- I’ll upload the artifacts by 11/30 and ping here when done.
- Can we lock a 30-minute call next week (w/ your auditor) to walk the artifact index? If yes, please propose 2 windows.

Thanks — we’ll keep the responses concise and mapped to the controls your auditors are asking about.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Attachment stubs: RDW_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); Retention_Matrix_v1.xlsx (XLSX); DPA_Redwood_v0.9.docx (DOCX); PenTest_Scope_Template.pdf (PDF)

From: Jane Park <jane.park@novaterra.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@novaterra.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-28 08:17 PST
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence scope, DPA alignment, and pen-test cadence

Thanks Irene — that aligns well. A few clarifications from our side:

- Retention: settlement-level records need 7 years; transaction trace logs can be 2 years. Our compliance team will want to see the retention enforcement path (auto-delete vs manual archive).
- Pen test: vendor will not be allowed to hit production. Masked non-prod copy is acceptable but must preserve record linkage for transaction tracing.
- DPA: I attached Novaterra_DPA_Template_v3 to the Drive folder — please produce a redline rather than a full rewrite.

Two quick asks for your timeline: can you include the log-access control matrix in the retention spreadsheet (who can access, how to request)? Also confirm whether audit logs are stored in our region by default or if cross-region replication is in use.

We can do a 30-minute artifact walkthrough on 12/02 10:00–10:30 PT or 12/03 14:00–14:30 PT. Prefer 12/02.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Jane Park
Sr. Manager, GRC | Novaterra Bank
jane.park@novaterra.com
(212) 555-0119

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@novaterra.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@novaterra.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30 09:45 PST
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence scope, DPA alignment, and pen-test cadence

Jane — quick update: I uploaded the retention matrix with the access-control column and a first-pass enforcement note (row comments). Link is the same Drive folder; I also flagged where audit logs are stored (us-west-2) and where we do replication (read-replication to eu-west-1 is opt-in).

Short answers to your clarifications:
- Retention enforcement: we use an automated lifecycle job for API and audit logs; settlement extracts are archived to a customer-controlled S3 bucket under a DPA-approved export cadence.
- Masking: we can provide a masked non-prod snapshot that preserves linkage keys but replaces cleartext PII; we’ll document the masking approach in the artifact index.

Irene — I added an owners column and a suggested handoff checklist for the auditor walk-through. I’m free to run the 12/02 10:00 PT slot — will block it.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachment stubs: Retention_Matrix_v1.xlsx (updated)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@novaterra.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@novaterra.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01 09:10 PST
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence scope, DPA alignment, and pen-test cadence

Jane & Carlos — Jordan here. Two operational notes on the pen-test and timeline:

1) Sandbox provisioning: we’ll stand up an ephemeral sandbox in us-west-2 with a dedicated read-only audit log export. Token will expire after the test window.
2) Pen-test window: propose 2026-12-13 to 2026-12-27 (2-week active window + buffer). If Novaterra prefers an earlier slot we can compress by one week.

Action items assigned:
- Jordan: create sandbox and produce test credentials + ephemeral log export (target 12/10).
- Neha: document masking approach and upload masked snapshot examples (target 12/08).
- Irene: produce SOC2 one-pager and DPA redline (Irene target 11/30; DPA redline target 12/04).
- Jane: confirm pen-test vendor and whether 2-week window is acceptable (Jane target 12/03).

I’ll open a support ticket for the sandbox provisioning and share the ticket id in the Drive.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough on 12/02.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com

Support ticket: #RDW-8892 (sandbox provisioning)
